name: Document: Write the house's language list and the translation rule as a versioned entry on the team home's definitions page
markdown_description:
P17 and P19. The list's definition (the union of field 14 across every open sheet plus every roster member's chosen language), its owner, its revision triggers (a sheet's field 14 changes; a chosen language enters the roster), and the rule that a language never leaves while a person who chose it is in the house; beside it the translation rule in one paragraph: one version number across languages, translator and two approvals, paid on the authorship model, software drafts read by a holder and disclosed, canon's terms untranslated and held. Pre-opening the list is filled from the seat sheets and the founders' languages and the entry says so. Written under canon's voice rules in every listed language. Extends `86akh5umr` and `86akh5ueg` by reference. Blocks I2 and row 132. High.

Filed by Session 11 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task `86ajgmj7c`. Reasoning lives on the S11 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc `2ky45bmy-17253`.
